name: WikiText-103: Language Modeling Dataset
description: WikiText-103 is a curated collection of over 100 million tokens extracted from the set of verified Good and Featured articles on English Wikipedia. Developed by Salesforce Research (Merity et al., 2017), WikiText-103 is over 110 times larger than the Penn Treebank (PTB) language modeling benchmark while retaining original casing, punctuation, and full numbers. It is partitioned into 1,801,350 training lines, 3,760 validation lines, and 4,358 test lines, designed for long-term dependency language modeling.
